page.overview:
Who is Squalo and Tiziano?

Ryan Colt Levy (English) [https://www.behindthevoiceactors.com/tv-shows/JoJos-Bizarre-Adventure-Golden-Wind/Squalo/] [Squalo]|alias=Tizza (Tiziano)}}

They are members of Passione and by extension, the Boss' Unità Speciale, and are the first members of the Guard Squad to face Team Bucciarati. They attempt to assassinate Team Bucciarati after they defect from Passione.

Squalo is the more ferocious, ruthless and hot-blooded of the two, while Tiziano is more tactical and level-headed. They are both Stand users and wield Clash and Talking Head respectively.

Squalo is a young man of slim build, keeping braided red hair.
